description: Covariance-model core for the NCR structural block: the mafft-xinsi seed alignment, hand/RNAalifold-derived secondary structure, and the cmbuild output built from it, for POLIO_unified's and NPEV_unified's 5' and 3' non-coding regions. Committed as inputs-of-record so a routine alignment build needs only mafft + Infernal (cmalign); rebuilding a CM from scratch additionally needs mafft-xinsi, which needs the mxscarnamod helper bioconda's mafft package omits (see scripts/setup_mxscarna.sh) -- a path that exists but is not expected to run even on a fresh clone.

reused_by.EV_unified: reuses npev_ncr_5p.cm and npev_ncr_3p.cm as-is (cmalign only, no new CM built) -- matches the shipped EV_unified.provenance.json's cm_reused field, and confirmed by grand_ev_unified's own working tree in MAD-VDPV carrying no .cm files of its own.

scrubbed: Each .cm's COM and DATE header lines (both the outer header and the internal HMM-filter copy) named an absolute local build path and a non-reproducible build timestamp. Both are replaced with fixed placeholder text; cmbuild_hand below records which convention actually built the file, since that information is otherwise only in the scrubbed COM line.
verified: Each scrubbed .cm confirmed to still run under `cmalign --outformat Stockholm` (exit 0, well-formed Stockholm output) after scrubbing, 2026-07-30.
